lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the visible dorsal-lateral surface, forming distinct vertical columns of approximately 5-7 spots each in the mid-body region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a rectilinear grid; high-luminance blobs are positioned as anchor nodes at these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the dorsal surface, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light-intensity crests and shadowed troughs.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, light-colored slender object (consistent with a remora) is attached to the dorsal surface near the base of the left pectoral fin.
